title: that is okay
body:
Our days together are slowly melting into weeks, months. Hours together turned into hours not together. Names you spoke of turned into memories of people I now possess as my own. 

People like to say your life is a mosaic of different people you meet. There are tiles being placed in my life with your hand placed over mine. 

Our quiet tones, the peace of knowing I am heard. I hear you in the silence.

The question is not if I love you. Rather, in what ways do I and why. 

It is difficult to explain why you love something without saying it in the terms of how it makes you feel. I do not only love you for the ways you make me feel. As I type these words I struggle to fight a sense of shame. Like vulnerability is the antecedent to my demise. 

I am full of contradictions. My ominous aura is not an act of nature. Perhaps my mission is to be filled with misunderstandings. I don’t know.

There are words and feelings I give you to bare. I say them with tears falling out of my eyes. I say I am not happy. I tell you ways you have hurt me. I explain how I hurt myself with my own thoughts. 

In my poor judgment, my fear is making you believe I dream of not being with you. That I let anxiety run my life. In truth, the happiness you give me is far vaster than any pain I have felt with you. 

I want a happy and healthy relationship with Liam.

Today, we watched a video 1 hour and 39 minutes long of two streamers playing Geoguessr. I don’t have precise words to explain my love for you. Instead, I could share a day with moments of knowing and feelings of my love for you. 

I wake up next to you. For a moment I forget you are there, in the next moment I remember. I hold you in my arms or you hold me in yours. I tell you good morning in the way I know reassures you. You smile and I say “LIAM’. Your joy reassures me that my love for you matters. 

I ask you to speak more or to sit up with the underlying knowledge that your calmness and silence is the peace you feel from knowing I care about you. I said, at times I feel lonely from this. Yet, in a deeper more meaningful sense, I feel cherished. 

We lay, for longer than we should or plan. We can lay and delay the day and it is okay. Everything is okay. You do not expect me to be anything or do anything or feel anything. I am quixotic and dramatic. It does not phase you. In the way my actions are not met with reaction. Somehow, I feel more seen. I am not a question or anomaly to you. I am who I am and everyday you choose to be with me. There is no amount of gratitude I could give you for giving me a space to be myself. In all the ways I’ve felt questioned or unwanted.

Somehow, you are perfect for me and I am I perfect for you. Despite all the ways we differ. In the ways you are not me, I find gaps in myself I did not know were empty being filled. 

We make our way to the car, in our own time. We drive without knowing where we are going. 
We find a place to eat then a place to go. I play chess and you watch Youtube. You know what they say, it is not about the destination. It is about the journey. Pardon my cliche. Perhaps this is where my love for you stems from. Knowing nothing is about the end goal or plan. Not the outcome. It is simply how we are able to enjoy all moments together without needing to accomplishing anything together. How some of my favorites times with you happened when we accomplished nothing we planned to. There is a lack of pressure I feel to impress you or prove anything.

In typing this maybe I found the words I was looking for. Jokingly, you are the left side and I am the right of a brain. Seriously, there is a balance your logic brings to my life I never realized was necessary. If I am the air floating around touching everything and holding nothing. You are the ground. A place to touch and rest. I am restless. In you, I feel grounded.

There is an absence of intellectual craving in my daily life. At times, I am learning about the world around me from you. I am not as connected to what is happening outside my world as you are. This is something I admire about you. The same way I adore how you invest yourself in your interests. Your plane tracker, Geoguessr, etc. It is not the fact your interests are niche that interests me. It is the attention you pay to your curiosities. 

I value sense of humor over other characteristics which others may see as more valuable. Although my deadpan delivery is hard for you to read occasionally. We are able to laugh together at uncapped amounts. 

This part may be controversial. Objectively, you may come across as nonchalant and apathetic. At the end of the day, you are my sensitive boy. In your quietness, your actions show me how gentle and benevolent your soul is. I revere people who do not give away all of themselves to everyone. 

Gentle, you are so gentle with me. So patient, kind, understanding. Maybe you are still learning to understand me. Still, you understand I am not always my words or actions. You make me feel gentle.

Even now, as you sit at your desk studying and I lay on the bed writing this. Your presence has filled my life with an abundance of happiness. My baseline with you is happy. Something I did not conceive as possible. You make me happy. You make me loved. You make me love you more and more everyday.

Liam loves me and that is okay. I love Liam and that is okay.



I love you,

title: dysphoria
body:
Your fingertips pressed to your Adam's apple.
A turn of your neck with your palms pressed to your jaw.
Forcing your neck to crack.

I feel my eyebrows furrow. 
I turn away.
In a split second my nervous system decides whether to cower or let my thoughts escape off my tongue.
I sit.

Each breath becomes shorter than the last as you let your hand follow a familiar sequence.
Neck, Jaw, Head,
Exhalation becomes an option as more and more and more oxygen fills your lungs. 
I let the air in my lungs turn stale.
Tension builds in my shoulders, my toes, neck,
as I forget to breathe. 

The oxygen swells in your hands, feet, face
Tingling,
Coldness lingers then it flees to make room for the numbness.


It’s okay.


I am okay.


I tell you its anxiety. Its fear. Its okay to be scared. 

Yet, the anxiety crawls over you.
Begging.
Like a spider on your flesh, 
the tingle of it creeping over you turns into a bite.
It is no longer a question of sensations.
It is absolute.
It is in your skin.
In your veins.
Blood turns to poison.

I tell myself its anxiety. I am scared. Everything is not okay.
I feel the heat building in my chest, in my head.
I feel a rush of restlessness.
Unease.

It is absolute.
Reality shifts with each shift of weight from left to right, foot to foot.
Air stagnation disrupted. 

Dysphoria.

In an instance,
adrenaline, norepinephrine, cortisol,
come to comfort you.
As you sit in their care,
the snugness of unrest wraps its arms around you.
Unrelenting, refusing to let go.

Reality turns into a conversation topic rather than the conversation itself.
Ears turn to murmurs as the conservation floats to my mind.
Spike filled thoughts bounce around.
I am not real.
I am not real.
If I sit alone,
if I am alone. 
No one is there to make it real. 
I am not real.
This is not real.
I only need to escape, isolate.
If you are here to see this,
is it not just in my head. 

I am not real. 
This is not real.
I feel your touch on my skin, like a pinch.
This is real.
I hear your words. 
They collide with the jumble,
which do I respond to first.
Which voice is real.
How is anything real?
How can I sit and not feel it all when you are here with me.
You feel it with me.
If I run, who am I saving?
Am I saving you from a world you cannot see?
Am I saving myself from losing your world?

I hold your hand.
I tell you to squeeze mine.
I tell you I am here. 

I push your hand away.

The feeling comes back,
you hands rest in mine. 
Your heart, finds it place. No longer trying to escape your chest. 

I think to myself, my absences is better than the animosity of my psyche.

I think to myself, 

What are you thinking?

Is your mind anything like mine?

You do not understand each compulsion to check your body.
I do not understand each intrusive thought.
You say you are okay.
I say its okay.
Both are lies we tell ourselves to each other.

How do I make it okay?
How do I be okay with it?

I pull you in. 
You are real.
I am real.
This is real. 
How do I know what is real?
This is real.

title: goodnight
body:
At times, I sit and ponder the variations of emotional baselines. 
I imagine a life where mine rests in a happy state of contentment and positivity. Where mornings do not feel so long and nights are not fleeting. 
I feel the days tallying on my back. Each mark feels like another weight to bare. Another moment, another fear to cloud my mind. 
There was a brief period in my life where the mornings and nights melted into each other. There was no clear separation in how the suns positions altered my mental state. The day flowed into itself. Light became darkness. There was no nuisances to this. The day simply became night. 
Last night was confirmation of the embarrassing reality of my chemistry. I was not given the gift of a happy baseline. 
Last night, my sleep was taken from me. The body’s punishment for allowing anxiety to cloud my mind. For letting the anxiety creep in and take over. I spend the day clenching my jaw and tensing my muscles. I cannot eat. My body is focused to work harder than it needs to. Therefore, during the night I am punished. My body takes the rest my mind steals from it during the day.
I hallucinated voices and figures as my body stood still. My mind forced my body to wake from its rest. The anxieties I relentlessly suppressing forced their way out.
I am shameful of how I think and process the world. I am envious of people who do not tangle their thoughts into one another. In how it feels like a losing battle to turn my insecurities into strengths. My false realities somehow made their way into truths. 
Tonight, I will go to sleep. I will try again tomorrow to not get lost in the entanglement of my thoughts. I will find a way to feel sensations other than the chemicals in my mind. I will feel the world on my finger tips and not the world in my mind. My head, is not my home. Yet, I cannot escape it.
Goodnight,
